title: Concept: Cross-origin credentials enabled in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, credentials are enabled for cross-origin responses. The browser will attach cookies and read the response, so the boundary between origins is now governed entirely by the allow-origin value. Middleware that reflects the request origin turns this into cross-site data theft.
applicability: javascript APIs consumed by browser clients.
risk: Authenticated cross-origin data exposure; MEDIUM severity.
